name: Media++
author: AJ Kulundu
description: MPRIS media player with seeking, shuffle and repeat, vinyl artwork, animated progress styles, a settings panel and hotkeys

barWidget.description: Now-playing with seek bar, shuffle/repeat, and cover art

schema.label: Label width
schema.description: Width of the track label on the bar, in pixels. Fixed so the bar does not reflow on every track change.

schema.label: Carousel speed
schema.description: Multiplier on the scrolling pace of a long title. Below 1 is slower.

schema.label: Pause between cycles (s)
schema.description: How long the title holds still between scroll passes, in seconds.

schema.label: Seek step (s)
schema.description: Seconds the -/+ buttons and the b/f keys jump. One of 5, 10, 15 or 30 -- other values snap to the nearest, so the button icon always matches what it does.

schema.label: Popup artwork
schema.description: "square" keeps the cover's own aspect ratio; "vinyl" fills a record that turns while playing.

schema.label: Progress animation
schema.description: "default" is a plain bar, "wiggle" is the Material 3 Expressive wave, "pacman" eats his way along a row of pellets. The retired "stripes" value is read as "pacman".
